name: Hornfolk seal on the secret door to the Cradle
notes: The stone door in the east wall of Horn's Hall (mw-e26.10 AC-2), the secret sorcerer route to the Cradle (bible 4.2 and the books paragraph: fragments of Hornfolk inscription unlock the Cradle's secret route). Magically sealed: keys and picks fail until a spell dispels it. Reading the runes beside the door with the fragments in hand (a bead filed from mw-e26.10) is what lets a sorcerer do so; nothing in the greybox does yet.
hint: Cut with runes that you only half read. The stone is humming.
